quotes.text: And I think it will be a big issue in communications networks generally because we are going to see AI deployed widely to support communications and, you know, cross the internet, and we want to make sure that it is being, again, deployed in a trustworthy way.
What benefits would there be from integrating AI into our Nation's energy sector? And would you want that sooner rather than later, and all the permitting to be reasonably quick?
What happens if they intercept and take over our AI? What happens then?
